units.source_text: 昨夜的兴奋和焦躁，一到天亮简直就像个玩笑。

en.t: By daybreak, last night's excitement and agitation seemed almost like a joke.

units.source_text: 当然，它会成为暂时的好谈资吧。

en.t: Of course, it would make good conversation for a while.

units.source_text: 男人又扫视一下周围，像是用眼睛在确认已经成为回忆的东西，

en.t: The man looked around once more, as if confirming with his eyes the things that had already become memories,

units.source_text: 然后，他急不可待地收拾起行李来。

en.t: and then, unable to wait any longer, he began packing his things.

units.source_text: 衬衫、裤子里都灌满了沙子，沉甸甸的。

en.t: His shirt and trousers were both filled with sand and felt heavy.

units.source_text: 要从服装的纤维里完全抖落沙子，

en.t: To shake every grain of sand completely out of the fibers of his clothes

units.source_text: 比完全刮掉头上的头皮屑还要困难。

en.t: was even harder than scraping every bit of dandruff from his head.
